Quæstio I. An, ut Deo sine exceptione obediendum, ita & magistratibus.

Index quæstionum, quibus hic tractatus continetur, & absoluitur.

Index rerum memorabilium & notatu dignarum.

book: Beza's treatise 'De iure magistratuum in subditos' (Frankfurt, 1604; Latin translation): a dedication, two exhortations (to kings and to subjects), one treatise of ten questions, and three indexes.
